title: Authenticate private-graph int64 proofs
objective: Authenticate existing checked-region int64 interval proofs against the complete private graph at emission time without expanding proof coverage

oracles: Existing checked int64 helpers and generated tagged C

handoff.summary: Existing checked-region int64 interval proofs now require emission-time structural authority over the complete authenticated private graph. Tagged and direct-result emission cache one verifier per function; any executable IR, root guard, graph membership, partial-map, or claim mutation retains checked add/subtract/multiply helpers without changing proof coverage.
risks: The change intentionally authenticates only existing interval proofs; it does not prove additional hot arithmetic sites.
Full pnpm test:native remains an integration-lane validation because it is costly and the focused compiler suite covers the changed authority path.
next_steps: Run the full native suite after integration.
Treat any future affine or loop-induction proof expansion as a separate theorem and benchmark slice.
